term: Integrated demand and portfolio planning — Strategic planning
front:

[EN] Integrated demand and portfolio planning is a controlled process supporting the Integrated End-to-End Governance & Synergy service line.

term: Integrated demand and portfolio planning — Strategic planning
front:
[ID] Fungsi utama strategic planning untuk integrated demand and portfolio planning?
[EN] What is the main function of Integrated demand and portfolio planning — Strategic planning?
[DOMAIN] Integrated End-to-End Governance & Synergy
back:
[ID] Fungsinya menyelaraskan integrated demand and portfolio planning dengan kebutuhan layanan, kapasitas, keselamatan, dan target operasi.

term: Integrated demand and portfolio planning — Strategic planning
front:
[ID] Manfaat utama strategic planning untuk integrated demand and portfolio planning?
[EN] What are the main benefits of Integrated demand and portfolio planning — Strategic planning?

back:

[EN] Benefits include service reliability, visibility, productivity, asset utilisation, and cost control.

term: Integrated demand and portfolio planning — Strategic planning
front:
[ID] Risiko utama strategic planning untuk integrated demand and portfolio planning?
[EN] What are the main risks affecting Integrated demand and portfolio planning — Strategic planning?

back:

term: Integrated demand and portfolio planning — Strategic planning
front:

front:
